description.en: A growing collection of plugins for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的插件合集，持续增加。

description.en: Ask for a diagram and get a checked, interactive page right in the conversation: Archify's architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, state, ER, class, tree, timeline and waterfall diagrams, from a description, Mermaid or your code, or a one-page explainer. Or skip the prompt: in the Archify panel, pick a diagram type (each card shows what it looks like, with a live example), optionally a project folder to draw from its code, and press Generate; the plugin scans the repository, starts the conversation and follows it, and the page lands in the panel's gallery. In the gallery, Edit changes a diagram through the conversation that drew it, and Review has the model review an architecture from its code: every point cites files and lines, and the plugin checks each citation. A How to use card takes you to where each thing is done. Fast by default: architecture diagrams are laid out by the plugin, schema slips and repository evidence are fixed before checking, and a one-call repository scan with a code map spares the model its exploring. Bundles the Archify skill by tt-a1i and renders it with the Harness's own runtime, no Node.js install needed. Bilingual.
description.zh: 说一句要什么图，对话里就出现一张检查过、能交互的页面：Archify 的架构图、流程图、时序图、数据流图、状态图、ER 图、类图、树图、时间线、瀑布图，照描述、Mermaid 或代码来画，也能把回答做成一页讲解。也可以不写提示词：在 Archify 面板里选图的类型（每种都配着示意图和可交互的示例），想从代码画就再选个项目文件夹，点「生成」，插件扫描仓库、开会话并跟进进度，画好的页面收进面板的图库。在图库里，「改图」交给画这张图的会话去改；「点评」让模型读代码评审架构，每条结论都附文件和行号，并经插件逐条核对。「怎么用」卡片把每件事列成一行，点了直接到做这件事的地方。默认就快：架构图由插件排版，格式小错和仓库证据在检查前就修好，一次调用的仓库扫描带代码地图，模型不用四处翻代码。内置 tt-a1i 的 Archify 技能，用 Harness 自带的运行时渲染，不用装 Node.js。中英双语。

description.en: Grok-style bot teams for one-person companies and role-split work: hire a ready-made team (one-person company, software squad, content studio, research desk) in one click, each bot with its own persona, avatar, model, skills, abilities, apps and scheduled tasks, and its own memory, summarized after every task and consolidated nightly with the team's shared notes and each project's own memory; notes about something with a date are forgotten after it. Bots message each other; one dispatcher hands out the work of every team you hire, through the team's lead, and a bot you make yourself joins any team you hired, or a team of your own with your name, description and colour. A board shows everything you asked for as cards, restated in a line, with how far each got: filed under projects with their own folder and brief, numbered like OPC-12 so a message can name one; file a card yourself, let one wait for others, or turn labelled GitHub issues into cards, on github.com or GitHub Enterprise. Built on Harness: reuse your installed skills, import skills from GitHub or a local folder or let a bot write its own, and import MCP servers from Codex, Claude Code or Cursor. Run a bot on your own endpoint or the Codex CLI's ChatGPT login; conversations start a new topic before they grow too big; a usage view counts tokens and cost by bot, task and day. Send a bot images in the panel: it sees them and hands them on with the work. Message the team from Feishu / Lark, Telegram, Slack or Discord and get the reports back in the chat.
description.zh: 把 Grok bot 搬进 DeepSeek Harness：给一人公司和分工协作场景的 bot 团队。一键雇用现成团队（一人公司、研发小队、内容工作室、研究台），每个 bot 有自己的人设、头像、模型、技能、能力、应用和定时任务，还有自己的记忆：每个任务后自动总结，每晚和团队的共享笔记、每个项目自己的记忆一起整理，有日期的笔记过了日期就忘掉；bot 之间私信协作，雇几个团队都由同一个调度员分派，交给各团队的负责人，自己建的 bot 也能放进任意已雇的团队，也可以自己建团队（自己起名字、写简介、选颜色）；看板把你交给团队的每件事做成卡片，用一句话写清楚、标出做到了哪一步，按项目归档（项目有自己的文件夹和简介），带 OPC-12 这样的编号，消息里提编号就能找到它；可以自己建卡、让卡片等别的卡做完再开始，也能把打了标签的 GitHub issue（github.com 或 GitHub Enterprise）变成卡片。充分复用 Harness：直接用已装的技能、从 GitHub 或本地文件夹导入、或让 bot 自己写技能，从 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 导入 MCP 服务。bot 可以用自定义端点或 Codex CLI 的 ChatGPT 登录；对话太长前自动开新话题；用量页按 bot、任务、日期统计 tokens 和费用。面板里能给 bot 发图片，它看得到，转出去的活也带着。在飞书、Telegram、Slack 或 Discord 里就能给团队派活，汇报回到聊天里。

description.en: Ask for a picture and get one: a generate_image tool for the model, backed by your provider's image model, with the picture shown in the conversation and an Images panel collecting everything drawn as a gallery to browse, enlarge and download. A settings drawer picks the provider, key and model (searchable as you type); every picture shows what it cost, with the public LiteLLM price list covering models the provider does not price. Ask for a GIF and it draws a sprite sheet and assembles a looping animated GIF from it; pass reference images (attachments, files, earlier results) to edit or build on them.
description.zh: 要一张图就给一张图：给模型一个 generate_image 工具，用你供应商的生图模型出图，图直接显示在对话里；「图片」面板把画过的都收成图库，可浏览、放大、下载。设置抽屉里选供应商、密钥和模型（输入即可模糊搜索），每张图都标出费用；供应商不给价的模型用公开的 LiteLLM 价目表兜底。要动图时让模型画一张精灵图，自动拼成循环播放的 GIF；也能带参考图（对话附件、文件、之前生成的图）改图或接着画。

description.en: English under every prompt: a translation when you write in another language, a correction or other ways to say it when you write in English, and a vocabulary book to review what it taught.
description.zh: 在每条 prompt 下方写一行英文：用其他语言写的给出英文，用英文写的给出纠错或更地道的说法；教过你的说法收进生词本复习。

description.en: Your Photos library on a night globe that zooms to street level: every place you took a photo glows, thumbnails pop up where you were, and zoomed in you get 3D terrain and buildings, the venues and landmarks from your own photos, and Wikipedia nearby. Trips are found for you and replay as a story; replay your years chapter by chapter as the camera flies to each trip and city with its best photos; each day brings back this date in your photos and in world history near places you have been. Open any place and the best photos come first. Ask the model about your photos and the map moves as it answers. Basemaps: night OpenStreetMap, Amap for China in full detail, satellite, offline. macOS Photos, read-only. Bilingual.
description.zh: 把“照片”图库放到一颗能一路放大到街道的夜色地球上：拍过照的地方都会发光，缩略图从你去过的地方冒出来；放大后有 3D 地形和建筑、你照片里认出的店铺和景点，还有附近的维基百科条目。旅行自动整理好，可以用故事模式回放；回放这些年时镜头一章章飞到每次旅行和常待的城市，放出最好的照片；每天翻出往年今天的照片，以及发生在你去过的地方附近的历史上的今天。打开任何地点都先看精选的好照片。在对话里问模型你的照片，地图会跟着动。底图可选夜景 OpenStreetMap、国内最详细的高德、卫星或离线。只读 macOS“照片”图库，中英双语。
